text:
Priya (partnerships): quick sync — we need a tight checklist for the marketplace release + SI onboarding. timeline draft attached?
Ben L: thanks. can we confirm landing page freeze date? ops wants code freeze Fri EOD PT.
Marco (product): landing page freeze = Fri EOD PT works. need final hero copy from comms by Thurs noon.
Jess (comms): copy incoming. also need embargo window confirmed for press — Anna?
Anna (legal): pressing on embargo: we can do a 24hr embargo but need partner sign-off by Thu COB. share partner MSA snippet asap.
Priya (partnerships): action items:
- Partners: final logos + legal signoff — Thu COB
- Comms: hero copy + blog draft — Thurs noon
- Eng: staging landing up + feature-flag A/B test — Wed EOD
- SI: onboarding runbook + creds for SI testers — Thurs AM
Sam (eng): I'll stand up staging page today. staging URL: https://staging.marketplace.redwood.ai/marketplace-launch ; feature flag toggle below:
```
# temporary flag for rollout testing
ffctl set marketplace_launch true --env=staging
```
Ben L: can we schedule a joint dry run with SI and comms? want to rehearse press flow and partner crediting.
Priya (partnerships): yes — propose Mon 11am PST dry-run (full script + checklist). who can lead cadence?
Marco (product): i'll run the product demo segment. Sam can handle cutover runbook. Jess lead press ops.
Jess (comms): I'll prepare the embargo announcement template and blog preamble. will ping partners channel when ready. :thumbsup:
Anna (legal): tagging legal-review: please drop the partner MSA redlines into the doc by Thu 3pm. otherwise we push embargo back.
Sam (eng): quick tech blocker — SI needs access to a GPU-backed test SKU for hardware partner integration testing. @deploy-bot can you provision a short-lived node?
deploy-bot: request received. provisioning gpu-test-01 to the "marketplace-si-test" project, TTL=48h. will post creds to vault when ready.
Ben L: awesome. any plan for rollback if partner images fail cert?
Marco (product): fallback plan: route to public hosted variant with partner crediting disabled, and show a banner: "Temporarily using hosted variant — partner credits will appear after validation."
Priya (partnerships): finalized timeline (subject to signoffs):
- Wed: staging landing up + SI initial smoke test
- Thu: partner assets + legal signoff complete
- Fri EOD: landing page freeze (content + A/B configs locked)
- Mon next week 11am PST: dry-run with SI + comms + partners
- Tue next week 9am PST: soft launch to select tenants, observe metrics
- Wed next week: full catalog publish + press release (embargo lifts)
Jess (comms): I'll draft the press release and share in /docs/marketplace/press-drafts. want eyes from partnerships + legal before sending.
Priya (partnerships): thanks team. callout: priority = legal signoff + partner final assets. if either slips, postpone embargo. any immediate blockers?
Ben L: none from sales side. just waiting on partner logos.
Sam (eng): will need SI test results by Thu noon to unblock Fri freeze.
Anna (legal): will review doc by Thu 3pm. if I see risky clauses I'll flag here.
Priya (partnerships): great — i'll follow up with partners and create a short checklist doc in the partnerships drive. tagging folks for the dry-run calendar invite. :spiral_calendar_pad:
Marco (product): ping me if you need extra props for demo or a short recording for partners.
Jess (comms): sending hero copy in 30m.
Priya (partnerships): end — will post updated checklist after Thu sync.
